attributes.title: UDA Convention 2027
attributes.summary:
The Utah Dental Association's 2027 convention takes place February 18 and 19, 2027, at the Salt Palace Convention Center in Salt Lake City; registration opened October 1, 2026, and the convention program was posted on November 1. The UDA lists the convention among its CE opportunities.

CE credit follows the instructional hours actually attended, so a three-hour course counts as 3 CE credits. Only the hands-on courses need a separate sign-up; other lectures are first come, first served. One fee covers both days, and lower fees apply before January 1, 2027. The fee amounts appear only as images on the convention website, so they are not listed here; check the registration page for current prices.
